title: Prepare the Release runtime environments
goal: Create reproducible Release root and Pico bridge uv environments for the supported Franka/Pico collection workflow without starting or controlling hardware.
doneWhen: Release root .venv is created from the approved RLinf environment definition and can import the Release framework and adaptation layer.
Pico bridge .venv is created from pico_bridge/pyproject.toml and can import its non-vendor dependencies.
Required external bindings are checked and any unavailable vendor package is reported without substitution.
No robot, camera, gripper, Pico service, Ray cluster, or live launcher is started.
decisions: Environment preparation is offline installation and import validation only; it is not authorization for a live hardware session.
Franky/libfranka and xrobotoolkit_sdk are vendor/external bindings and must not be replaced by guessed packages.

verification.summary: Release root and Pico bridge uv environments were created; root Franka dependencies and focused no-hardware checks passed.
checks: Root environment imports franky, ray, evdev, zmq, cv2, lerobot, RLinf Franka environment, LeRobot writer, and rig extension
Release-focused pytest: 4 passed; launcher shell syntax and Python compilation passed
No Release Ray cluster was started
limitations: xrobotoolkit_sdk is absent from pico_bridge/.venv and must be installed from the vendor-compatible SDK package before Pico publishing can run.
A Ray status query encountered authentication failure against an existing external Ray endpoint; no Ray process was started, stopped, or modified.
No hardware, Pico PC Service, camera, gripper, or end-to-end collection run was exercised.
